name: io.github.drawcall-ai/drawcall
title: Drawcall
description: Discover Drawcall workflows for 3D apps and asset creation; read APIs and approve CLI logins.

tools.name: intro
tools.description: Returns recommendations for which Drawcall tool or library suits a task, such as finding, generating or modeling 3D assets, and how to find detailed instructions for each.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Searches Drawcall guides and API declarations for building interactive 3D apps, games and assets: rendering, physics, rigging, level of detail, asset sourcing from @drawcall/market and generation with @drawcall/generate. Covers all supported packages, including in an empty project. Searches documentation, not Market inventory. Returns up to five guide or declaration paths with excerpts.

query.description: What you want to implement or learn how to do

tools.name: read_skills
tools.description: Returns the content at a Drawcall guide or declaration path: a SKILL.md returns the full guide with its workflow and prerequisites, a declaration returns API details, and a package path returns a listing of its guides and declaration sources. Listing names are relative to the path that was read.

path.description: A path from search or a listing, e.g. /@drawcall/physics/

tools.name: approve_login
tools.description: Approves a pending Drawcall CLI login, identified by the user_code that `drawcall auth login` printed, as the connected account. This grants that CLI a full account session; the CLI finishes signing in with `drawcall auth complete`.
